subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】on 在……上; in 在……里; under 在……下; chair 椅子; desk 书桌; cap 帽子; ball 球; car 小汽车; boat 小船; map 地图; toy 玩具; box 盒子
【重点句型】Where is ...? ……在哪里？ It's in/on/under ... 它在……里/上/下。 Is it in ...? 它在……里吗？ Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. 是的。/ 不是。 Silly me! 我真傻！
【A Let's talk】John: Where is my pencil box? Sarah: It's in your desk. John: Where is my ruler? Sarah: It's under your book. John: Oh, silly me! Thanks.
【Read and write】Where is the car? It's under the chair. Where is the ball? It's in the box. Where is the boat? It's on the map. Where is the cap? It's on the desk.
key_points: Is it in ...? 它在……里吗？
Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. 是的。/ 不是。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
